Commercial Cleaning Prices: What to Expect and How to Budget

May 08, 2024

Keeping an office building, retail store, medical facility, or other commercial space sparkling clean is essential for healthy, safe environments. While in-house janitorial staff can provide maintenance-specific cleaning services, hiring professional commercial cleaning companies offers whole-building services saving clients valuable time and hassle. Assessing average commercial cleaning prices and understanding which key aspects drive costs help managers find the right service fit.

Table of Contents

Average Commercial Cleaning Rates Per Square Foot

Most commercial cleaning servicesbase quotes on the total square footagecleaned along with commercial cleaning cost factors with service frequency. Exact rates vary by region but national averages as of 2023 are:

  • Office Cleaning– $0.10 to $0.25 per square foot monthly

  • Medical Facility Cleaning– $0.13 to $0.30 per square foot monthly

  • Retail Store Cleaning– $0.08 to $0.20 per square foot monthly

On the lower end, a 5,000-square-foot professional or office space averaging $0.15 per square foot pays about $750 monthly for weekly commercial cleaning.

Medium-sized companies around 20,000 square feet fetch better pricing, perhaps $0.13 per square foot. So they pay $2,600 monthly for nightly cleaning.

Larger commercial facilities like a 100,000-square-foot warehouse expect even better rates thanks to economies of scale. Billed at $0.10 per square foot, monthly cleaning costs equal $10,000.

Cleaning frequencies ranging from daily, nightly, bi-weekly, or weekly determine total monthly costs based on labor hours and supplies needed per building.

Factors Impacting Commercial Cleaning Costs

Several factors account for fluctuating price points when requesting bids from various cleaning companies. Considerations include:

Facility Type & Size

Larger commercial spaces over 100,000+ square feet secure more affordable commercial cleaning rates chart based on efficiencies of scale. According to 2023 data published by ISSA, the worldwide cleaning industry association, typical commercial office cleaning costs range between $0.10 – $0.40 per cleanable square foot area.

Cleaning Frequency

Daily cleaning requires greater staff hours than bi-weekly or weekly visits. More frequent visits mean higher monthly fees as cleaners need consistent staffing, supplies, and oversight.

Scope of Services

General cleaning like vacuuming, floor mopping, and trash removal falls on the low end of rates while specialized cleaning services medical facilities or food industry cleaning incorporate sanitization requirements.

Specialized Services

Add-ons like pressure washing, carpet shampooing, window cleaning, or construction site cleaning demand specialized equipment and technicians therefore higher quotes.

Regional Labor Rates

The cleaning industry relies heavily on human capital. So average regional worker wages and cost of living adjustments impact how many employees and commercial cleaning rates to attract qualified staff.

Cleaning Chemicals Used

Commercial cleaners selecting greener eco-friendly options may charge slightly elevated rates if sustainable supplies cost more than generic chemical variants.

Average Cleaning Prices For Different Commercial Spaces

While exact rates fluctuate based on the above factors, here are rough ballpark quotes for common commercial facility cleaning:

Office Cleaning

From private law firms to sprawling corporate campuses, office cleaning represents a major commercial cleaning services sector. For 10,000+ square foot buildings, expect roughly $0.15 to $0.25 per square foot for nightly or weekly light and janitorial services and cleaning consisting of:

Trash and Recycling Removal

  • Emptying central bins from conference rooms, break areas, individual workstations, lobby welcome centers, and private offices

  • Collection sorting into dedicated eco-friendly recycling streams

  • Changing plastic liners and wiping debris from existing bins

  • Consolidating larger bags for seamless removal through loading docks

Thorough Vacuuming

  • Clearing all reachable floor areas using commercial-grade vacuums with HEPA filtration

  • Moving light furniture pieces like chairs and small tables to fully access dirt below

  • Carefully vacuuming underneath desks, inside cubicles, and hard-to-reach corners

  • Quickly addressing any minor spills spotted and notifying management of larger issues

Sanitary Restroom Hygiene

  • Fully stocking toilet paper rolls, paper towels, hand soaps

  • Disinfecting countertops, toilet bowls, bathroom doorknobs

  • Sweeping and mopping floors

  • Taking out trash bags tied off tightly

  • Deep scrubbing sinks, faucets, shower stalls, replacing air fresheners

Tidy Break Rooms & Kitchenettes

  • Loading dishes left in sinks into commercial dishwasher

  • Wiping down counters, tables, and hard surfaces

  • Sweeping and mopping floors

  • Trash removal and new bin liners

  • Dusting vents above refrigerators and microwaves

  • Proactively restocking paper supplies

Surface Dusting and Disinfection

  • Wiping down lobby chairs, directory kiosks, guard stations

  • Topping off wall-mounted hand sanitizer dispensers

  • Lifting paperwork and files to dust underneath

  • Disinfecting telephones, desktops, keyboards

  • Dusting baseboards, vents, overhead lighting, and fixtures

Medical Office Cleaning

Protecting staff and patients means medical settings like clinics, surgery centers, and doctors’ offices require vigilant cleaning to meet healthcare industry standards. Hospital-grade disinfectants and stringent protocols result in elevated rates of around $0.20 to $0.30 per square footmonthly.

Retail Cleaning Services

Customer-facing locations must present clean, visually appealing shopping environments. Department stores, malls, boutiques, and strip center retail cleaning quotes averaging $0.10per hour upto $0.25 per square footdepending on foot traffic volume.

Restaurant Cleaning

From fast food chains to upscale dining establishments, eateries generate significant daily debris from food prep, spills, and high guest volume. Restaurant and cleaning company typically charges an hourly rate for daily services averaging $300 to $600 monthly. More culinary equipment and grease buildup equals higher rates.

Industrial Cleaning Services

Warehouses, factories, distribution hubs, and utilities comprise industrial settings needing periodic cleaning tailored to workflows. Fewer occupants than offices or retail means lower per-square-foot rates ranging from $0.08 to $0.15 on average. Some equipment and inventory require specialized cleaning.

Gym & Fitness Studio Cleaning

Wellness centers with pools, locker rooms, exercise equipment, and studios need germ-conscious cleaning given patron sweat and contact. The 24/7 operation and hygiene demands result in monthly cleaning rates from $500 and up.

What Influences Specific Commercial Cleaning Services Pricing?

On top of the base rate for routine and professional cleaning services, certain jobs like carpets, windows or construction sites incur additional service costs based on various factors:

Carpet Cleaning

Charged by the square foot depending on:

  • Method – steam, bonnet, or dry compound

  • Traffic volume

  • Furniture moving

  • Stain removal

Typical rates run $0.05 to $0.20 per square foot.

Floor Waxing & Buffing

Usually charged hourly or per square foot depending on:

  • Floor area size

  • Type – VCT tile, stone, concrete

  • Materials used – acrylic, polymer wax

  • Equipment needed – weighted floor buffer

Approximate range is $0.05per sq ftto $0.15 per square foot.

Pressure Washing

Several elements comprise exterior pressure wash pricing:

  • Building height

  • Access difficulty

  • Exterior square footage

  • A mix of glass, concrete, stone, etc

The average cost of a single-story 5,000 sq ft building starts around $100. High-rise office towers cost thousands.

Post Construction Cleaning

General contractors hire subcontractor cleaning crews for detailed site interior build cleanings after finishing major renovations or ground-up construction. Bid pricing factors include:

  • Type of cleaning – dust wipe down, debris removal, finish ready, broom sweep certified

  • Building size

  • If assets remain on-site

  • Cleaning materials permitted based on building ownership

Quotes are provided on a case-by-case basis.

Window Cleaning

Charged per pane inside and out reflecting elements like:

  • Pane count

  • Height/stories

  • Specialized equipment

  • Environmental factors

Typical range is $3 to $12 per interior glass pane. Exterior higher based on difficulty.

Janitorial Staffing

Some organizations hire commercial cleaning companies solely for reliable employee staffing. Cost markups on quoted staffer hourly rates account for elements like:

  • Insurance

  • Bonding

  • Payroll/Taxes

  • Training

  • Equipment

Government wage standard rules often dictate baseline janitorial pay rates.

Being aware of the factors comprising cleaning rates for different building types and services allows managers to compare bids apples-to-apples.

How to Choose the Right Commercial Cleaning Service

Selecting a partner to maintain cleanliness across office buildings, medical centers, retail stores or other properties carries great responsibility. Prioritizing worker expertise along with patron health and safety through stringent cleaning protocols saves hassle long-term.

Follow this criteria when evaluating area service providers bidding on your business premises:

Assess Company Stability & Experience

Seek established providers with 5+ years of actively servicing local businesses similar to yours. Request evidence of proper business licensure, liability insurance certificates, and workers’ compensation policies remain active.

Vet Hiring & Screening Standards

Ask about requirements for past experience, reference checks, multi-point background clearances, and drug testing. Reputable agencies only dispatch carefully selected personnel upholding the highest ethical standards who reliably represent your brand.

Compare Cleaning Checklists & Processes

Do side-by-side comparisons of included tasks against your location’s needs. Validate bidders thoroughly detail shiny floor vacuuming, sanitary restroom wiping, germ-busting disinfectant usage plus accelerated attention targeting high traffic zones.

Contrast Equipment & Supply Inventory

Ask for an inventory listing of commercial machinery like auto-scrubbers for accessing tall or expansive areas along with ample latex gloves, microfiber cloths, and enough all-purpose cleaner volume to fulfill scheduled visits.

Request Copies to Compare Service Bids

Secure an accurate visual reference of key quoted specifics including basic tasks, specialty add-ons like carpet services, approximate commercial cleaning cost, staff hours anticipated, and projected annual investment.

Discuss Staffing Philosophies

Know whether crews reflect full-time employed W-2 cleaners instilled with company pride versus independent subcontractor models potentially resulting in inconsistent quality.

Verify Happy Current Clients

While testimonials posted on company websites serve a marketing purpose, also inquire about contacts for at least 3 references actively serviced for 1+ years validating responsive account management and satisfactory outcomes.

Questions to Ask For Transparent Pricing

Because specific client needs vary so widely, reputable cleaning firms provide customized quotes after facility walkthroughs detailing:

  • Square footage

  • Cleaning frequency

  • Number of cleaners per visit

  • Exact services included/excluded

  • Line item specialty service costs

  • Total monthly/annual estimate

Get upfront about true commercial cleaning costs by asking:

  • Are supplies & equipment included or extra fees?

  • What employee screening processes do you follow?

  • Can you share referrals from current similar clients?

  • Are cleaners W-2 employees or subcontracted?

  • What insurance policies does your company carry?

  • How often are employees trained?

  • How are misses or complaints addressed?

  • How can we best customize scheduling around our needs?

  • What green equipment & supplies do you use?

Established commercial cleaning services happily clarify pricing and provide obligation-free quotes. Finding ones taking pride in their work ensures your premises shine while freeing up valued time for core business needs.

In Summary

Partnering with professional cleaning companies specialized in maintaining different commercial spaces offers a budget-friendly solution. Rather than obsess over minor rate variations in bids, focus discussions on the exact service scopes proposed. Seek providers enumerating detailed task checklists, equipment inventory lists, and transparency around hiring processes. These practices reveal more about true commercial cleaning job quality than pure price points alone.

Prioritize working with responsive teams answering your unique usage needs versus vague promises of rock bottom rates. Consistently clean, sanitized properties ultimately save companies far larger sums through higher productivity, workplace safety, and elevated patron experiences driving revenue. Keep an eye on the deeper organizational benefits commercial cleaning facilitates rather than purely initial price comparisons.
